title: Compute EPS using if-converted method for convertible securities

items.concept: Period-end adjusting JE for convertible-bond interest accrual (emphasis); initial recognition at par; subsequent-measurement interest schedule; basic and diluted EPS under the if-converted method (full year and mid-year issuance); conversion settlement JE after paying accrued interest; income-statement EPS presentation

Number-variant twin: period-end interest accrual AJ on convertible debt; subsequent measurement interest schedule; if-converted diluted EPS reconciliation; initial recognition at par; conversion settlement after paying accrued interest; EPS presentation

Period-end preferred-dividend adjusting/declaration JE; if-converted diluted EPS for convertible preferred; preferred issuance and conversion settlement; diluted EPS when company has a net loss (antidilutive exclusion and disclosure); mid-year actual bond conversion and if-converted full-year dilution logic
Classification — which computational method applies to convertible securities; identifying dilutive vs antidilutive outcomes under if-converted (loss-year exclusion)
